object.attr: The design shows these rows; the code shows the pace of the quickest split of qualifying workouts, and no date. The record distances stay 1 km, 5 km and 10 km whichever distance unit is selected. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: The app shall show, for the 1 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, the shortest time of a continuous segment of that distance in the saved workouts, with the date of the record.
